Let \(A=(0,0), B=(a,0), D=(0,b), C=(a,b)\).  
Let \(E=(x,0)\) on \(AB\), \(F=(x,b)\) on \(CD\), \(G=(0,y)\) on \(AD\), and \(H=(a,y)\) on \(BC\).

Then
\[
[EBH]=\frac12(a-x)y=6 \implies (a-x)y=12.
\]
\[
[DGF]=\frac12 x(b-y)=8 \implies x(b-y)=16.
\]
\[
[ECG]=\frac12\bigl((a-x)y+bx\bigr)=18 \implies (a-x)y+bx=36.
\]

From \((a-x)y=12\) and \((a-x)y+bx=36\), we get
\[
bx=24.
\]
Then from \(x(b-y)=16\),
\[
24-xy=16 \implies xy=8.
\]
Thus
\[
\frac{y}{b}=\frac{xy}{bx}=\frac{8}{24}=\frac13,
\]
so \(y=\frac b3\).

From \((a-x)y=12\):
\[
a-x=\frac{12}{y}=\frac{36}{b}.
\]
Also \(x=\frac{24}{b}\), so
\[
a=\frac{24}{b}+\frac{36}{b}=\frac{60}{b}.
\]
Therefore
\[
[ABCD]=ab=60.
\]

\[
\boxed{60}
\]
